elements.description: Browse covers in 3D: the front one faces you, the others stack up on both sides.

properties.name: items
properties.description: The covers, in order: an image or your own content each, with a title and subtitle for the caption

properties.name: index
properties.description: The front cover; unset starts on the middle one

properties.name: itemWidth
properties.description: Cover size in px – scales down on narrow containers

properties.name: itemHeight
properties.description: Cover height in px – scales down with the width

properties.name: angle
properties.description: How far the side covers turn away, in degrees

properties.name: reflection
properties.description: Mirror the covers on the floor

properties.name: caption
properties.description: Title and subtitle of the front cover

properties.name: renderCaption
properties.type: ((item: CoverFlowItem, index: number) => Node | string | null | undefined) | undefined
properties.description: Replaces the default caption: returns a node (cloned) or text

properties.name: controls
properties.description: Previous / next buttons next to the caption

properties.name: ticks
properties.description: A row of small position ticks under the caption

properties.name: sound
properties.description: A soft click each time a new cover reaches the front

properties.name: selectable
properties.description: A click or Enter on the cover in front fires tc-select

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-index-change
events.description: Cancelable, when a drag, flick, key or click asks for a cover; detail: CoverFlowIndexChange ({ index })

events.name: tc-front-change
events.description: Each time a new cover reaches the front while the row moves; detail: CoverFlowIndexChange ({ index })

events.name: tc-select
events.description: A click (or Enter) on the cover in front, when `selectable`; detail: CoverFlowSelect ({ item, index })

cssProperties.name: --tc-cover-flow-shadow
cssProperties.value: 0 1px 2px light-dark(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)), 0 10px 20px -12px light-dark(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent), 0 12px 24px -14px light-dark(transparent, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6))

props.name: items
props.description: The covers, in order: an image or your own content each, with a title and subtitle for the caption

props.name: index
props.description: Controlled front cover – changes are asked for through onIndexChange

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Starting cover when uncontrolled – defaults to the middle one

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Uncontrolled: called as each new cover reaches the front. Controlled: called with the cover a gesture settles on

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Clicking (or pressing Enter on) the cover in front

props.name: renderCaption
props.description: Replaces the default caption (title and subtitle)
